title: НА + accusative: For a week, the next day

blocks.text: НА + Accusative indicates how long something is expected to last.

«The preposition НА + Acc. is used: (a) to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last; (b) after the verb опаздывать / опоздать to indicate the amount of time by which someone is late.» «Note also such expressions as: на следующий день — (next day).»

DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.
